title: Unit 8 Review: Lessons 1 to 4
source: Henry's Unit 8 lesson packs (M.3 Communication), Nov 13. American spelling (apologize, not the British -ise).

questions.q: Sasha is speaking to her teacher. Which apology is the most formal?
choices: I apologize for calling Ben that name.
questions.read_aloud: I apologize for calling Ben that name.

questions.q: Luis feels bad about his angry words. "I'm really sorry for ___ you."
questions.read_aloud: I'm really sorry for upsetting you.

questions.q: I never have time for my hobbies. "I wish I ___ more free time."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I had more free time.

questions.q: I didn't do my homework and the teacher was angry. "If only I ___ my homework."
questions.read_aloud: If only I had done my homework.

questions.q: Mint: "I'm tired." Report it: Mint said she ___ tired.
Beam: "I've finished." Report it: Beam said he ___ .
Ellie: "I'll call you tomorrow." Report it: Ellie said she would call me ___ .
questions.read_aloud: Ellie said she would call me the next day.

choices: He said me he was sorry.
He told me he was sorry.
He told that he was sorry.
He said to me that sorry.
questions.read_aloud: He told me he was sorry.

questions.q: Tom: "Where are you going?" Report it: Tom asked Ava where ___ .
questions.read_aloud: Tom asked Ava where she was going.

questions.q: Ava: "Did you see it?" Report it: Ava asked him ___ he had seen it.
questions.read_aloud: Ava asked him if he had seen it.

questions.q: Ruth: "Don't shout!" Report it: Ruth told Luis ___ .
questions.read_aloud: Ruth told Luis not to shout.

questions.q: Beam: "No! I won't help." Which reporting verb fits? Beam ___ to help.
